name: BlackPoll Fleet International, Inc.
summary: BlackPoll Fleet International, Inc. offers a comprehensive suite of services, primarily centered on the aviation industry. The company excels in aircraft management for both fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft, alongside providing aviation business development and contract procurement expertise. Their operational capabilities include air cargo services, managing long-term aircraft leases and charters, and delivering thorough maintenance and overhaul for various types of aircraft. Additionally, they are involved in the development and operation of fixed base operations (FBOs). The firm further specializes in a diverse array of critical support functions, such as full-service aircraft, crew, maintenance, and insurance (ACMI) leasing, passenger flight operations, and support for offshore drilling endeavors. Their offerings also extend to aerial mapping and surveillance, air ambulance services, essential logistical and airlift support, search and rescue missions, VIP transportation, emergency evacuations, and humanitarian relief efforts. They also manage aviation fuel provision and execute specialized insertion and extraction operations. Beyond aviation, BlackPoll Fleet International provides sophisticated logistics management tailored for demanding industries like construction, mining, logging, and other heavy industries operating in remote environments. Established in 2011 and headquartered in Sunrise, Florida, the company adopted its current name in June 2015, having previously been known as Basta Holdings, Corp.
